UPDATE "Transaction"
              SET "amount" = ?1, "netAmount" = ?1,
                  "preTaxAmount" = ?2, "taxAmount" = ?3, "taxRate" = ?4,
                  "budgetId" = CASE WHEN ?5 THEN ?6 ELSE "budgetId" END,
                  "note" = CASE WHEN ?7 THEN ?8 ELSE "note" END
            WHERE "id" = ?9
